record.question: The hallmark ECG feature in acute myocardial infarction is:
options: Appearance of q waves in leads in which it is normally absent
Inversion of T waves in the precordial leads
Elevation or depression of ST segment in two or more contiguous leads
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Elevation or depression of ST segment in two or more contiguous leads. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 11, printed Q26. Source limitation: “Hallmark” is underspecified for all acute myocardial infarctions, and option C conflates ST elevation with ST depression. Rewrite by asking specifically for the STEMI criterion or for common ischemic ECG changes. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
